title: A constant possibility
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: A cosmological constant is a term in Einstein's equations that can behave like a constant vacuum-energy density. It is one possible description of dark energy.

misconception: A learner may choose: A measurement proving space never expands
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What is a cosmological constant in cosmological modeling?
